feature_audit.remaining_time_ms: Clock state known at the decision point; sourced from clock and checked against position features.
feature_audit.legal_move_count: Current board legal-move count; available from the current position.
feature_audit.capture_count: Legal capture options in the current position.
feature_audit.checking_move_count: Legal checking options in the current position.
feature_audit.side_in_check: Current check state from the board.
feature_audit.material_white: Current material balance feature from the board.
feature_audit.material_black: Current material balance feature from the board.
feature_audit.material_imbalance: Difference between the two current material features.
feature_audit.king_safety_basic_indicator: Current deterministic king-safety feature from the position.
feature_audit.side_to_move_is_white: One means White to move; zero means Black to move.
feature_audit.completed_depth: Teacher-independent depth reached by the bounded Phase 2A probe; requires such a probe before a future decision.
feature_audit.total_nodes: Teacher-independent nodes counted in the bounded Phase 2A probe; requires such a probe before a future decision.
feature_audit.total_search_time_ms: Elapsed time of the bounded Phase 2A probe, not the selected teacher target; available only after the probe.
feature_audit.timed_out: Whether the bounded Phase 2A probe hit its deadline.
feature_audit.analysis_budget_ms: Configured cap for the bounded probe; known before running it.
feature_audit.max_analysis_depth: Configured depth cap for the bounded probe; known before running it.

search_telemetry_availability: Search summary features require an existing bounded probe search. Depth profiles and teacher-derived transition summaries are excluded.
